# `aitbc governance profile delegate`

Delegate a profile's voting power to another profile (caller-bound or admin).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance profile delegate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile-id` | text | — | yes | Delegator profile ID |
| `--delegatee-id` | text | — | yes | Profile ID receiving the delegated power |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance profile delegate --profile-id <profile_id> --delegatee-id <delegatee_id>
```
